claims.text: Engagement is one of Meta's six campaign objectives. You pick it at campaign level, then choose where the engagement happens, such as on your ad or in a messaging app. The choice also decides which placements and calls to action you can use.

claims.text: It replaces the older Engagement objective one for one. Some older objectives also map onto it: video views (as engagement type), messages (messaging apps) and conversions (website or app).

claims.text: Engagement is a goal you set at campaign level. It is not an audience restriction. Most objectives now ask for a conversion location, and some also ask for a conversion event.

evidence.source_title: Available conversion locations and events by objective in Meta Ads Manager

evidence.locator: Campaign level in Meta Ads Manager
evidence.source_title: Create ad campaigns in Meta Ads Manager

claims.text: For Engagement, the conversion location can be on your ad (video views, post engagement or event response), a messaging app (Messenger, WhatsApp or Instagram Direct), your website, your app, or a Facebook Page.

evidence.source_title: Available conversion locations and events by objective in Meta Ads Manager

claims.text: On your ad, in a messaging app or on a Facebook Page, no conversion event is required. Website and app locations offer events such as add to wishlist, contact, subscribe or view content.

evidence.source_title: Available conversion locations and events by objective in Meta Ads Manager

claims.text: Use it when your goal is interaction rather than a sale or lead: video views, post engagement, event responses, conversations in Messenger, WhatsApp or Instagram Direct, or lower-funnel website or app actions such as add to wishlist.

claims.text: Do not rely on it when you need purchases, leads or catalogue sales. The mapping table points those goals to the Sales and Leads objectives, and ThruPlay or 2-second video views can also sit under Awareness.

sections.summary: Meta names the objective and the conversion location choices, but not the exact menu labels or defaults. This path stops where the documentation does.

claims.text: In Ads Manager, create a new campaign and choose Engagement from the six objectives.

claims.text: Choose the conversion location where you want the engagement to happen: on your ad, a messaging app, website, app or Facebook Page.

evidence.source_title: Available conversion locations and events by objective in Meta Ads Manager

claims.text: If you chose on your ad, select an engagement type: video views, post engagement or event response.

evidence.source_title: Available conversion locations and events by objective in Meta Ads Manager

claims.text: If you chose a messaging app, select Messenger, WhatsApp or Instagram Direct.

evidence.source_title: Available conversion locations and events by objective in Meta Ads Manager

claims.text: If you chose website or app, select the conversion event you want people to take.

claims.text: Cost per engagement, such as cost per video view or per post interaction, may fall if you pick the engagement type that matches your real goal, because delivery is steered to that action. The trade-off is that it may bring fewer purchases or leads than a Sales or Leads campaign.

evidence.source_title: Available conversion locations and events by objective in Meta Ads Manager

claims.text: Conversation volume in messaging apps may rise if you set a messaging conversion location. Conversation quality and downstream sales are not covered by this objective, so check them separately. Nothing here guarantees an uplift.
